description: This file contains unit tests for the HomePageService class in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It verifies that the service correctly retrieves default page paths for various modules based on user roles, utilizing mocking and dependency injection.

classes.name: HomePageServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of HomePageService methods related to retrieving default module pages and home page paths, using mock objects to simulate dependencies.

methods.name: testGetHomePagePath
methods.description: Tests that HomePageService correctly retrieves the home page path using the BasicUserRoleManager mock.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Tests retrieval of default page for a specific module ('admin') via the service.

methods.name: testGetTimeModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Verifies that the service returns the correct default path for the Time module.

methods.name: testGetLeaveModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Verifies default path for the Leave module.

methods.name: testGetAdminModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Verifies default path for the Admin module.

methods.name: testGetPimModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Verifies default path for the PIM module.

methods.name: testGetRecruitmentModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Verifies default path for the Recruitment module.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Verifies that null is returned when no default path is available for the Performance module.
